title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree program in Computer Science or related technical field.
qualification: Pursuing a degree in CS or related quantitative discipline; coding proficiency in C++, Java, Python, or Go.
description: Work on core product infrastructure, scalable software platforms, and real-world technical problems alongside experienced mentor engineers.

title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
eligibility: Graduate students, young professionals, and researchers from over 160 eligible countries globally.
qualification: Completed undergraduate degree with strong academic standing and demonstrated leadership qualities.
description: Enables graduate students and young artists/researchers to pursue master's or PhD degrees in top universities across the United States.

title: Associate Software Engineer
eligibility: Open to entry-level software developers globally with strong self-direction.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in CS or equivalent boot camp/self-taught experience; familiarity with Ruby on Rails, Go, or Vue.js.
description: Contribute to an all-remote global DevOps platform, assisting in feature engineering, fixing bugs, and enhancing open-core software functionality.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 18+ actively enrolled in high school, college, or university programs.
qualification: Student status and passion for building AI-driven solutions to real-world global problems.
description: A premier global technology competition empowering student entrepreneurs to build viable startups using Microsoft AI and cloud computing technologies.

title: Junior Data Analyst
eligibility: Early-career professionals or recent graduates with 0-2 years of analytical work experience.
qualification: Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, CS, or quantitative discipline; skill in SQL and Python/R.
description: Analyze complex datasets, construct interactive dashboards, and synthesize operational insights to optimize business process automation.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide; no prior computer programming background necessary.
salary: Free to audit (Optional paid verified certificate)
description: An entry-level computer science course teaching algorithmic thinking, software engineering design, problem solving, C, Python, SQL, and web technologies.
